practice.title: Practice settings
practice.namePlaceholder: Shown in the app and on every chart
practice.nameLockedLoading: The practice name is locked until your team loads — retry below.
practice.nameLockedShared: The practice name is shared by the whole team — only the primary owner can change it.
practice.nameSaveFailed: Could not save the practice name.

discard.title: Discard the practice name change?
discard.message: The new practice name hasn’t been saved.

logo.label: Practice logo
logo.empty: No logo uploaded — charts use the template's built-in mark.
logo.removeMessage: New charts and PDFs will use the template’s built-in mark until you upload another.

team.title: Team
team.settingUp: Your practice is still being set up.
team.ownerBlurb: Colleagues you add share this practice’s charts, templates, and images.
team.memberBlurb: You’re a member of {{practice}}. You share this practice’s charts.
team.inviteHint: No account yet? We'll email them an invite to set a password and join.
team.invited: Invite emailed to {{email}} — they set a password and they're in.
team.existingAccount: {{email}} already has a ToothOps account — we emailed them a link to accept. They'll appear here once they join.
team.failed: That didn’t work. Please try again.
team.transferMessage: The primary owner holds billing and the practice name. You stay an owner of the practice.
team.removeMessage: They lose access to the practice’s shared charts but keep any charts of their own.

ownerReport.title: Owner report
ownerReport.blurb: The report families take home after a dental visit — sections, headings, wording, language, and the practice-wide default layout.

clientLanguage.title: Language for pet owners
clientLanguage.blurb: The language used for text families receive, such as owner report defaults. Typed text is never translated.

deletion.title: Delete practice
deletion.blurb: Permanently deletes the practice and every chart shared with it, including your team’s, and cancels any subscription. Team members keep their accounts and private charts.

logoErrors.tooLarge: That image is too large — logo files must be under 10 MB.
logoErrors.reportTooLarge: Those owner report settings are too large (50 KB max) — shorten some text or remove a template.
logoErrors.reportNotLoaded: Your saved owner report templates didn’t load, so saving now could overwrite them. Reload the page and try again.

chart.title: Chart settings
chart.noteAccount: Just for you — these follow your account on every device. Changes save right away.
chart.noteBrowser: Saved in this browser. Changes apply right away.

charting.title: Charting
charting.pocketRootHint: M / D, or MB / MP / D on three-rooted teeth
charting.spaceDown: Moves down to the next tooth
charting.spaceDownHint: fast for calling out a run of depths
charting.scoreTap: After tapping a score in the grid
charting.scoreFinding: Go to the next finding on the same tooth
charting.scoreTooth: Go down to the next tooth
charting.scoreToothHint: for scoring one finding across the mouth

beside.title: Beside the teeth
beside.show: Show findings on the Diagnosis diagram

anesthesia.title: Anesthesia
anesthesia.blocksNote: A hidden block still shows on a chart where it has a dose.
anesthesia.usualNote: Offered as one tap on a chart with no anesthetic set.
anesthesia.adjunctNote: Added to the mix (optional), e.g. buprenorphine or dexmedetomidine. “Use my usual” then charts both.
anesthesia.adjunctAria: Usual drug added to the mix
anesthesia.adjunctStrengthAria: Strength of the drug added to the mix

pdf.title: PDF
pdf.gridHint: (optional while findings are on the diagram)

chart.noteDevice: Saved on this device. Changes apply right away.
chart.spaceMovesDownHint: Fast for calling out a run of depths
chart.scoreTapToothHint: For scoring one finding across the mouth
chart.columnsFooter: Columns shown in the charting grid. At least one stays on.
chart.pdfGridHint: Optional while findings are on the diagram

quickCodes.title: Quick codes
quickCodes.note: One-tap buttons for codes you chart often, such as T/SN (supernumerary tooth). They appear under the diagnosis note in By tooth and above the Diagnosis diagram.

exam.title: Exam
exam.areasNote: Added after the six built-in areas, each with Normal / Abnormal and a comment. Only the areas you answer print on the PDF.
exam.addPreset: Add the full oral exam list

feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.bugPlaceholder: What you did, what you expected, what happened instead…
feedback.note: Goes straight to the ToothOps developer, who’ll reply to your email.

gettingStarted.tourFooter: A short tour of where everything lives in the chart.

sections.body: A dental record, top to bottom. Tap the chart’s title to jump between sections — everything autosaves.

grid.body: Per-tooth measurements. Tap a cell and type, or tap a score — chart without looking up.

diagrams.body: Tap a tooth to mark it; switch between Comment and Draw, add free notes. Undo and Redo are in the diagram’s toolbar.

codes.body: Search the full AVDC code set here, right with the diagram.

treatment.body: Write the report, or insert a saved template — and save new ones to reuse.

patients.title: Patients
patients.body: Every patient’s visits. Saved visits open read-only until you tap Edit. Rechecks lists the patients due for a recheck.

share.title: Share the PDF
share.body: Build the client-ready chart PDF with your logo, then share or save it whenever you’re ready.

whatsNew.severalTeeth: Tap tooth numbers in the grid to select several, then set one score on all of them.
whatsNew.customize: Every page has Customize in its More menu: hide columns, choose what shows beside the teeth, and more. Settings follow your account to every device.
whatsNew.leftOff: Opening ToothOps fresh shows Patients — unless today’s visit is still open — and today’s visit opens ready to edit.

reminders.sendFrom: Send a reminder for one patient from Patients or Rechecks.
reminders.settingUp: Your practice is being set up — check back in a moment.
